title: Topology-aware mamba for crack segmentation in structures (CrackMamba)
mechanism: ImageNet-pretrained VMambaV2 encoder, snake-scan module that reorders crack feature sequences, and three-branch snake-conv VSS blocks in a new decoder.
adaptation: Pretrained encoder makes it the Mamba model most likely to compete at 478 images. Gray to 3 channels, 24-class decoder, house loss, PF-style reduced encoder lr.
min_experiment: Arm: CrackMamba 24-class with PF-style encoder lr; baseline: PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU, relF1@2, mIoU_rob. Kill if CV crack IoU < PF minus 0.01.
evidence: R: SOTA on CrackSeg9k and SewerCrack, competitive on CHASE_DB1 vessels (numbers not in abstract).

alt_notes.adaptation: Pretrained encoder helps at 478 cells; gray to 3 channels, 24-class decoder, house loss, PF-style encoder lr to keep pretraining.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: CrackMamba with PF-style schedule; baseline PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill as a model if CV crack IoU < PF minus 0.02; keep as benchmark row.
